Addon 1: 15 min (with the items); Addon 2: several hours + waiting for the flower (up to 1 month)

The two addons of the {wiki:Druid Outfits|Druid Outfit}. The first (bear/wolf paws) is a simple swap with {npc:Ustan} in Port Hope. The second (bear/wolf skin) requires earning the respect of the druid {npc:Ceiron}, in Ab'Dendriel, with four tasks (a rare flower in Nargor, pure water from a hydra cave, demon dust and a lost necklace in the Orc Fortress) until you can talk to the she-wolf Faolan in Cormaya.
Peaceful, nature-loving druids may enjoy this outfit, especially the animal-like addons. I have heard there is a druid living near Ab'Dendriel who may be able to provide suitable addons.
Premium Account (the base Druid Outfit is available to all Premium players; this quest only gives the addons).
No minimum level, but 100+ recommended (hydras, demons and Orc Fortress).
Access to {wiki:Nargor} for the Griffinclaw flower.

Druid Outfit addon 1: Bear Paws (male) / Wolf Paws (female)
Druid Outfit addon 2: Bear Fur (male) / Wolf Fur (female)
Collect the 50 {item:Bear Paw|Bear Paws} and the 50 {item:Wolf Paw|Wolf Paws} before talking to Ustan to save time.
The {item:Blooming Griffinclaw} only blooms roughly once a month and stays in flower only between two Server Saves. Start mission 1 now and stop by Nargor regularly.
Don't lose the {item:Ceiron's Waterskin}: Ceiron won't accept just any other waterskin.
Collect 50 {item:Bear Paw|Bear Paws} and 50 {item:Wolf Paw|Wolf Paws}. You can collect them before you start.
Male Druid with the Bear Paws addon
Female Druid with the Wolf Paws addon

Go to **Port Hope** and go up to the upper floor where {npc:Ustan} is. Say {key:hi}, {key:addon}, {key:bear paws} and {key:yes}. He keeps the paws and gives you the addon. To get to Port Hope, take the boat at your city's port ({key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes}; for example {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais). You arrive next to {npc:Charles}, who also takes you back.
For the second addon you have to earn the trust of {npc:Ceiron} and then of {npc:A Majestic Warwolf|the she-wolf Faolan}. First you have to learn the language of wolves.

Go to **Ab'Dendriel** and talk to the druid {npc:Ceiron}: say {key:hi}, {key:outfit}, {key:faolan}, {key:yes} and {key:yes}. He gives you a {item:Botanist's Container (Empty)} and asks for a sample of the blooming Griffinclaw.
If you lose the container, Ceiron won't give you another: you have to buy one from a representative of {wiki:The Explorer Society}.

{wiki:Nargor} is a pirate island west of Liberty Bay. Take a boat to **Liberty Bay**. There, talk to {npc:Captain Waverider}: {key:hi}, {key:peg leg}, {key:yes} (50 gp) to go to **Meriana**. In Meriana, **south** of Sabrehaven, ask {npc:Sebastian}: {key:hi}, {key:nargor}, {key:yes} (50 gp).
Waverider only takes you to Meriana after the mission *Access to Meriana* of the {wiki:The Shattered Isles Quest}.

Go to {wiki:Nargor} and go up to the 3rd floor above ground, in the **northeast** area. The Griffinclaw is there. It is usually {item:Dry Griffinclaw|dry} and of no use. It blooms roughly once a month and is in flower only between two {wiki:Server Save|Server Saves}: you may have to go back many times.
Nargor is full of pirates. Go prepared.
When you find it in bloom ({item:Blooming Griffinclaw}), use the {item:Botanist's Container (Empty)} on it. You receive a {item:Griffinclaw Container}.

If you try to collect more than one sample, this message appears: *"You just collected a fragile griffinclaw. At least wait for the rest of the plant to recover a bit before gathering more."* If you already have this addon, you cannot interact with the flower again.

Go down the mountain the same way to where you landed and talk to {npc:Sebastian} of Nargor: {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes} (100 gp) to go straight back to Liberty Bay (or {key:meriana}, 50 gp). For Ab'Dendriel, take a boat in Liberty Bay (for example to Venore or Thais and from there to Ab'Dendriel).
Go back to Ceiron and say {key:hi}, {key:griffinclaw} and {key:yes}.
3. Mission 2: pure water from the hydra cave
Tell Ceiron {key:hi}, {key:task} and {key:yes}. He gives you the {item:Ceiron's Waterskin}.

Go to the {creature:Hydra|Hydra} spawn in the mountains between Ankrahmun and Tiquanda and head for the **easternmost** lake (one floor up). The simplest way is from **Ankrahmun** via the {wiki:Kha'zeel Pass}: leave the city to the **west** and climb the mountains ({creature:Hyaena|Hyaenas}), cross the bridge at the top (there is a {creature:Nomad} and a few {creature:Bandit|Bandits}) and go down to the stairs to the jungle side; the hydra spawn is in the mountains **north** of that area (see coordinates). You can also come on foot from **Port Hope**, east through the Tiquanda jungle.
{creature:Hydra|Hydras} are dangerous. Go with a suitable level and supplies.
From Ankrahmun via the Kha'zeel Pass (1)
From Ankrahmun via the Kha'zeel Pass (2)
From Ankrahmun via the Kha'zeel Pass (3)
Use the {item:Ceiron's Waterskin} directly on the **trickle of water** ("trickle"), not on the lake: using it on the lake does nothing. When it works you see the {item:Ripple Effect|ripple effect}.

Go back the same way: go down to the spawn floor and return across the Kha'zeel Pass bridge to **Ankrahmun** (or through the jungle to **Port Hope**). In Ankrahmun, {npc:Captain Sinbeard} takes you by boat to Edron, Venore and other cities; from there you continue to Ab'Dendriel.
Go back to Ceiron and say {key:hi}, {key:water} and {key:yes}.
Tell Ceiron {key:hi}, {key:task} and {key:yes}. He wants 100 ounces of {item:Demon Dust} as proof that you are "on the right side, against Zathroth".

Buy the {item:Demon Dust} from other players, or use a {item:Blessed Wooden Stake} on the fresh corpse of a {creature:Demon} (it doesn't always work). Ceiron says a priest can help you get the blessed stake.
{creature:Demon|Demons} are very dangerous. Only hunt them if you have the level and equipment for it; otherwise, buy the dust.
Go back to Ceiron and say {key:hi}, {key:demon dust} and {key:yes}.
Tell Ceiron {key:hi}, {key:task} and {key:yes}. He lost his wolf tooth necklace (it has the letter "C" engraved on one tooth) when he fled from the {wiki:Orc Fortress}.
Finding the necklace in the Orc Fortress

The {wiki:Orc Fortress} (Ulderek's Rock) is **northwest** of Venore and **southeast** of Ab'Dendriel (see coordinates); walk there from one of those cities. In the {wiki:Orc Fortress}, go down to the same floor as the {wiki:Orc Fortress Quest}. The necklace is in a hidden room **west of the stairs**. Pick up the {item:Ceiron's Wolf Tooth Chain}. It is **2 floors below** ground level.
The fortress is full of strong orcs ({creature:Orc Berserker|Orc Berserkers}, {creature:Orc Leader|Orc Leaders}).
Since the patch of 9 February 2021 you can also buy the necklace from {npc:Black Bert}, in Thais.
Go back the same way: go up the stairs (or use the {item:Rope} where you went down through holes) to the surface of the fortress and walk back to Ab'Dendriel, to the **northwest**.
Go back to Ceiron and say {key:hi}, {key:wolf tooth chain} and {key:yes}.
Tell Ceiron {key:hi} and {key:faolan}. He casts a spell on you so you can speak the language of wolves for a while, and tells you that Faolan sleeps in a cave in Cormaya.
The spell only lasts a while: go straight to Cormaya.

Ceiron's spell is short-lived, so go right away. From Ab'Dendriel, {npc:Captain Seagull} takes you to **Edron** ({key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}, 70 gp). On the boat **north** of Edron, talk to {npc:Captain Seahorse}: {key:hi}, {key:cormaya}, {key:yes} (20 gp). You disembark at the **north** port of Cormaya, next to {npc:Pemaret}.
Go to **Cormaya** and go down to the cave of {npc:A Majestic Warwolf} through the marked entrance.
Tell {npc:A Majestic Warwolf} {key:hi}, {key:addon} and {key:yes}. You receive the second addon.
Male Druid with the Bear Fur addon
Female Druid with the Wolf Fur addon
Go back up where you went down into the cave and return to the **north** port of Cormaya. {npc:Pemaret} takes you to Edron ({key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}, 20 gp).
The two addons are independent: you can do Ustan's without doing Ceiron's and vice versa.
The addons are available for both the male and the female versions of the Druid Outfit.
